description: This file defines the main application component for a React-based frontend. It manages routing using a hash-based approach, handles user authentication state via API calls, and conditionally renders Login, Signup, or user-related UI components. It also sets up theme styling and navigation controls.

methods.name: useHashRoute()
methods.description: Custom React hook that manages lightweight hash-based routing, providing route state and navigation function.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main application component that manages user session state, theme setup, and conditional rendering of login/signup or main content.

methods.name: onLogout
methods.description: Handles user logout by calling API and resetting user state, then navigates to login route.
